name: Sotai
meaning: Ancestor of a family of Solomon's servants who returned from exile.
notes: Sotai was the ancestor of a family of Solomon's servants who were among the exiles that returned to Jerusalem from Babylon.

name: Stachys
meaning: Believer in Rome, greeted by Paul as a beloved friend.
notes: Stachys was a believer in Rome whom Paul greeted as his beloved friend.

name: Stephanas
meaning: Corinthian believer, baptized by Paul, sent to visit him.
notes: Stephanas was a believer from Corinth who, along with his household, was baptized by Paul and later visited Paul to provide support and encouragement.

name: Stephen
meaning: One of seven deacons, full of faith, performed miracles, martyred.
notes: Stephen, one of the seven deacons chosen by the early church, was full of faith and the Holy Spirit, performed miracles, and became the first Christian martyr after his powerful testimony before the Sanhedrin.

name: Suah
meaning: Son of Zophah, from the tribe of Asher
notes: Suah, a descendant of Asher mentioned in a genealogy.

name: Sukkiim
meaning: African people who invaded Judah under Shishak
notes: The Sukkiim were an African people who joined Shishak's invasion of Judah.

name: Susanna
meaning: Woman who helped support Jesus and his disciples
notes: Susanna was one of the women who provided for Jesus out of her resources.

name: Susi
meaning: Father of the Manassite spy Gaddi
notes: Susi was the father of Gaddi, the spy from the tribe of Manasseh.

name: Syntyche
meaning: Woman in the Philippian church whom Paul exhorted
notes: Syntyche was a prominent woman in Philippi whom Paul urged to reconcile with Euodia.

name: Tabbaoth
meaning: Family of temple servants who returned from exile
notes: The Tabbaoth were a family of temple servants who returned to Judah from Babylonian exile.

name: Tabeal
meaning: Man whom Syria and Ephraim wanted to make king of Judah
notes: Tabeal was the man Syria and Ephraim conspired to make king of Judah in place of Ahaz.

name: Tabeel
meaning: Persian official involved in accusing the Jews to Artaxerxes
notes: Tabeel was a Persian official who joined in writing an accusation against the Jews to Artaxerxes.

name: Tabitha
meaning: Charitable woman in Joppa whom Peter raised from the dead
notes: Tabitha, also called Dorcas, was a beloved disciple in Joppa known for her charitable works, whom Peter raised from the dead.

name: Tabrimmon
meaning: Father of Ben-hadad I, king of Syria
notes: Tabrimmon was the father of Ben-hadad I, the king of Syria who was an ally of Asa king of Judah.

name: Tahan
meaning: Son of Telah, from the tribe of Ephraim
notes: Tahan was a descendant of Ephraim, the son of Telah and father of Ladan.

name: Tahan
meaning: Son of Ephraim, ancestor of the Tahanites clan
notes: Tahan was a son of Ephraim and the ancestor of the Tahanites clan.

name: Tahash
meaning: Son of Nahor and Reumah
notes: Tahash was a son of Abraham's brother Nahor and his concubine Reumah.

name: Tahath
meaning: Levite of the Kohathite clan, son of Assir
notes: Tahath was a Levite of the Kohathite clan, the son of Assir and father of Uriel.

name: Tahath
meaning: Descendant of Ephraim
notes: Tahath, a descendant of Ephraim mentioned in the genealogy.

name: Tahath
meaning: Another descendant of Ephraim
notes: Tahath, another descendant of Ephraim mentioned in the genealogy.

name: Tahpenes
meaning: Egyptian queen who raised Hadad the Edomite
notes: Tahpenes was the queen of Egypt who gave her sister in marriage to Hadad the Edomite.

name: Talmai
meaning: King of Geshur; father of David's wife Maacah
notes: Talmai was the king of Geshur and father of Maacah, one of David's wives and mother of Absalom.

name: Talmai
meaning: Anakim king of Hebron, defeated by Judah
notes: Talmai was one of the Anakim kings of Hebron defeated by Caleb and the men of Judah.

name: Talmon
meaning: Levite gatekeeper who returned from Babylonian exile
notes: Talmon was a Levite gatekeeper who returned from Babylon and served at the temple.

name: Tamar
meaning: David's daughter, raped by her half-brother Amnon
notes: Tamar was David's daughter who was raped by her half-brother Amnon, leading to tragic consequences.

name: Tamar
meaning: Absalom's beautiful daughter
notes: Tamar was the beautiful daughter of Absalom, named after his tragic sister.

name: Tamar
meaning: Judah's daughter-in-law who bore Perez and Zerah
notes: Tamar was Judah's daughter-in-law who, after being wronged by him, bore twin sons Perez and Zerah.

name: Tanhumeth
meaning: Supporter of Gedaliah after Jerusalem's fall
notes: Tanhumeth the Netophathite was one of the leaders who supported Gedaliah's governorship after Jerusalem's fall.

name: Taphath
meaning: Daughter of Solomon; wife of Ben-abinadab
notes: Taphath was a daughter of Solomon who married Ben-abinadab, one of Solomon's district governors.

name: Tappuah
meaning: Son of Hebron from the tribe of Judah
notes: Tappuah was a son of Hebron, a descendant of Judah.

name: Tarea
meaning: Son of Micah and grandson of Mephibosheth
notes: Tarea, also called Tahrea, was a son of Micah and grandson of Mephibosheth.

name: Tarshish
meaning: Son of Bilhan from the tribe of Benjamin
notes: Tarshish was a son of Bilhan, a descendant of Benjamin.

name: Tarshish
meaning: One of the seven princes of Persia and Media
notes: Tarshish was one of the seven princes of Persia and Media who had access to King Ahasuerus's presence and held the highest positions in the kingdom.

name: Tarshish
meaning: Son of Javan, great-grandson of Noah
notes: Tarshish was a son of Javan and great-grandson of Noah, associated with the ancient city of Tarshish.

name: Tartan
meaning: Title of an Assyrian military commander
notes: The Tartan was a high-ranking Assyrian military commander who led campaigns against Ashdod and Jerusalem.
